body:
Founder real-time alert: 'redgarden build is down.' Root cause: S194-01 correctly updated scripts/build.sh's apps/arena target but missed scripts/build_arena.sh, a separate build path CI uses as a sanity check -- undefined reference to on_moon_zenith at link time. Reproduced locally, applied the same fix build.sh already had (-include bloodflower_mod_host.h + bloodflower_mod.c), verified clean build + full test_arena.sh suite green. Commit d5b1dd5, pushed.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed CI build break -- build_arena.sh missing bloodflower_mod.c
